caption: The drawing depicts a cabinet with three visible panels, standing on four round feet. The cabinet is rendered in shades of gray, blue, brown, and muted greens and features intricate decorative motifs. Each panel, including the two angled side panels, is adorned with detailed carvings of fruits, flowers, foliage, and ribbons, primarily rendered in white, gray, and pale tones, with the central panel displaying a large pear surrounded by other fruits and leaves. The side panels also contain vertical floral designs with clusters of fruits. The top of the cabinet is brown and shows a wood texture, with the cabinet viewed slightly from an angle to reveal depth. Fine lines and shading articulate the three-dimensional structure of the cabinet, and the background is plain with only a faint rectangular outline suggesting the drawing's frame.
title: Cabinet
